trainingRules.label: downside_continuation
trainingRules.condition: previous session drop <= -4% and current session remains negative, with stale chart rejected or VWAP not reclaimed
trainingRules.action: block long entry; keep as risk/off or short-watch signal for future downside model.

trainingRules.label: technical_rebound_watch
trainingRules.condition: previous session drop <= -5% and current session turns positive >= 3% with valid intraday volume confirmation
trainingRules.action: paper-only rebound watch; require VWAP hold, higher-low sequence, and prior breakdown-zone reclaim.

trainingRules.label: theme_follow_failure
trainingRules.condition: theme leader or group leader rises but related symbol fades or opens current session sharply down
trainingRules.action: do not promote by theme membership alone; require own-symbol liquidity and price confirmation.

trainingRules.label: relative_weakness_pocket
trainingRules.condition: symbol drops materially while its broad index is flat/positive or making highs
trainingRules.action: separate from index trend; inspect sector/corporate reason before any long candidate promotion.

trainingRules.label: stale_data_reject
trainingRules.condition: requested date differs from response tradeDate or chart last candle is older than two sessions
trainingRules.action: invalidate feature set and prevent candidate, signal, and training writes from that source.
